title: Cakeminator
statementMd:
You are given a rectangular cake, represented as an $*r* × *c*$ grid. Each cell either has an evil strawberry, or is empty. For example, a $3 × 4$ cake may look as follows:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a843eb25609a5da691d63517f0e3990bf1161a51.png)

The cakeminator is going to eat the cake! Each time he eats, he chooses a row or a column that does not contain any evil strawberries and contains at least one cake cell that has not been eaten before, and eats all the cake cells there. He may decide to eat any number of times.

Please output the maximum number of cake cells that the cakeminator can eat.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*r*$ and $*c*$ ($2 ≤ *r*, *c* ≤ 10$), denoting the number of rows and the number of columns of the cake. The next $*r*$ lines each contains $*c*$ characters — the $*j*$-th character of the $*i*$-th line denotes the content of the cell at row $*i*$ and column $*j*$, and is either one of these:

- '`.`' character denotes a cake cell with no evil strawberry;
- '`S`' character denotes a cake cell with an evil strawberry.

## Output

Output the maximum number of cake cells that the cakeminator can eat.

## Note

For the first example, one possible way to eat the maximum number of cake cells is as follows (perform 3 eats).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4768ab0699d83a2a41a4632bd6c3546896d42b5c.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e95a25f57b47a1806ff699c6a240c9edbfd3451f.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/206296f1cf421d61a2ee6e8a8776b01c267c57d7.png)
statementZhMd:
给定一个矩形蛋糕，它由一个 $*r* × *c*$ 的网格表示。每个单元格要么有一个邪恶草莓，要么为空。例如，一个 $3 × 4$ 的蛋糕可能如下所示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a843eb25609a5da691d63517f0e3990bf1161a51.png)

蛋糕终结者要吃掉这个蛋糕！每次吃蛋糕时，他会选择一个不含任何邪恶草莓、且至少包含一个此前尚未被吃掉的蛋糕单元格的行或列，并吃掉其中所有蛋糕单元格。他可以决定吃任意多次。

请输出蛋糕终结者最多能吃掉的蛋糕单元格数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*r*$ 和 $*c*$（$2 ≤ *r*, *c* ≤ 10$），分别表示蛋糕的行数和列数。接下来的 $*r*$ 行中，每行包含 $*c*$ 个字符——第 $i$ 行的第 $j$ 个字符表示第 $i$ 行第 $j$ 列的单元格内容，且为以下字符之一：

- '`.`' 表示没有邪恶草莓的蛋糕单元格；
- '`S`' 表示有邪恶草莓的蛋糕单元格。

## 输出格式

输出蛋糕终结者最多能吃掉的蛋糕单元格数量。

## 说明

对于第一个样例，一种吃掉最多数量蛋糕单元格的方法如下（共进行 3 次进食）。
